notes: A1863 is the Verizon/Sprint/China model. Models A1905 and A1906 (Japan) are also listed for iPhone 8.

method: IFixit's iPhone 8 teardown prints the model number A1863 on the box (step 3) and lists the chips found in its unit with part numbers, including 64 GB NAND flash (step 1 lists 64 or 256 GB models).
Apple's spec page lists models A1863 and A1905 and a built-in rechargeable lithium-ion battery.
Apple's model identification table lists A1863, A1905 and A1906 (Japan) under iPhone 8.

comps.spec: Apple A11 Bionic SoC, part 339S00434, with the M11 motion coprocessor embedded (steps 1 and 11)
2 GB LPDDR4x RAM, SK Hynix H9HKNNNBRMMUUR (step 11); Toshiba TSBL227VC3759 64 GB NAND flash storage (step 12; step 1 lists 64 or 256 GB models)
Qualcomm Snapdragon X16 LTE modem MDM9655 (step 11); Apple/USI Wi-Fi and Bluetooth module 339S00397 (step 12)
Apple/Dialog Semiconductor power management IC 338S00309 (step 12)
Texas Instruments SN2501 Li-ion battery charger (step 13)
Bosch Sensortec accelerometer/gyroscope, no part number listed; Bosch Sensortec pressure sensor listed as BMPxxx with a question mark, so no full part number (step 13)
Lightning connector, peach-colored, with a new bracket (steps 9 and 15); no part number stated
3.82 V, 1821 mAh, up to 6.96 Wh (step 7); no manufacturer or part number stated
Single 12 MP Wide camera, f/1.8 aperture, optical image stabilization
4.7-inch diagonal LCD, 1334 x 750 resolution, 326 ppi
Speaker (step 14); the same dozen donut speaker holes line the bottom of the phone as on the iPhone 7
Taptic Engine (step 9); no part number or voltage stated
Qualcomm WTR5975 gigabit LTE RF transceiver (step 12)
Skyworks SKY77366-17 quad-band GSM power amplifier module (step 11)
NXP 80V18 (PN80V) secure NFC module (step 11)
Qualcomm PMD9655 power management IC (step 12)
Texas Instruments SN61280E battery boost converter (step 13)
Broadcom BCM59355, likely an iteration of the BCM59350 wireless charging IC (step 12)
Cirrus Logic 338S00248 audio codec (step 12)
Audio amplifier, part 338S00286, manufacturer not stated (step 12)
7 MP FaceTime HD camera, f/2.2 aperture
Solid-state home button with Touch ID sensor and cable (steps 2 and 5)

Apple support: iPhone 8 technical specifications (A1863 listed; A11 Bionic; display; cameras)
